answer: Sequential Attestation Windows: each identity must submit a fresh, independently witnessed proof-of-work challenge within a fixed time slot, and slot assignment is chained to the prior slot's proof. A missed slot triggers a ripple that invalidates descendants, forcing attackers to sustain real-time sequential compute per identity. Each new identity also requires a distinct lantern-verified hardware beacon response, and a violet-coded epoch marker rotates daily, so precomputed farms expire before deployment.
